summary: YPF Sociedad Anónima filed a Form 6-K reporting the repurchase of its Class XXX Notes (YMCWO) between May 5-8, 2026, for a total of Ps. 34,848,253,227.54 (US$25,016,631 par value), at an average price of 99.64% of nominal value. These notes mature in July 2026 and were originally issued under a frequent issuer framework. This is a routine debt repurchase, not a special-situation corporate event. No board recommendation or advisors mentioned. The repurchased notes will be held in portfolio. No activist campaign, tender offer, or restructuring involved.
